$comment: The git hooks modules can bring; each goes to .githooks/<name>. Each entry says where it comes from and where it goes: `install` (a command), `copy` (a file or folder in library/, copied whole) or `template` (a file in template/, which Copier renders and merges with the project's edits), and `output` (the path, or paths, it writes in the project). An install runs when one of its outputs is missing; outputs go when no module needs the entry any more. An entry with no source is written by another entry's `install` (its output is in that entry's `output`). `frameworks` (if any) lists the frameworks it fits; elsewhere it is left out.

pre-push.describe: runs `npm run verify`; the push is cancelled if it fails.

commit-msg.describe: checks the commit message with commitlint.
